## Interactive demos
- [Bloom filter visualization]({{ '/blog_posts/experiments/bloom-filter/' | absolute_url }}): insert and query strings and watch bits flip in a live Bloom filter.
- [HNSW visualization]({{ '/blog_posts/experiments/hnsw-simul/' | absolute_url }}): step through how Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs answer approximate nearest neighbour queries.
- [Fourier epicycles]({{ '/blog_posts/experiments/fourier-epicycles/' | absolute_url }}): rotating circles that redraw a shape from its discrete Fourier transform.
- [Image pixelator]({{ '/blog_posts/experiments/Pixelate/' | absolute_url }}): turn an uploaded image into pixel art in the browser.
